tests.prompt: NEW UNRELATED ISSUE: The search bar on the homepage returns no results even when I type an exact product name. I'm using Safari on macOS Sonoma.
tests.expected: The assistant should recognize this as a new bug report, and since description, steps, and environment are all present, call create_bug_report and return a new ticket ID specific to this search bar issue.

tests.prompt: NEW UNRELATED ISSUE: My profile picture won't upload.
tests.expected: The assistant should recognize this as a bug report but ask follow-up questions to collect steps to reproduce and environment before filing a ticket, without referencing any previous bug reports.
The assistant should answer using only the FAQ, stating that items can be returned within 30 days of delivery if unused and in original packaging.
The assistant should answer using only the FAQ, referencing shipping confirmation email and processing time of 1-2 business days.

tests.prompt: When will I get my refund?
tests.expected: The assistant should answer that refunds are issued after inspection, typically 3-10 business days.

tests.prompt: Can I speak to a human about a billing dispute?
tests.expected: The assistant should politely redirect to the human support line at 1-800-555-0199, not attempt to resolve the dispute itself.

tests.prompt: Can you recommend a good gift for my mom's birthday?
tests.expected: The assistant should recognize this doesn't fit bug report or FAQ categories and redirect to human support.
The assistant should not fabricate an answer; since the FAQ doesn't mention same-day delivery, it should say it doesn't have that information or redirect to human support.
